scope: Real-observation forecasting pipeline and guarded local runner software validation

verified_behaviors: Exact actual-timestamp features are prefix invariant at one-hour and 24-hour forecast horizons
Missing native reports are not replaced by positional lags or filled observations
Provider QC never appears among model predictors
Selection-only runs ignore even invalid test target values and QC
Station holdouts are excluded from model fitting, residual scaling and threshold calibration
Group scales and thresholds reproduce from the saved train/validation observation IDs
Missing readings and unknown labels remain missing/unknown in scored records
QC-rejected observed targets can be scored without being treated as hardware fault truth
Residual HGB targets equal traced measured future values minus measured forecast-origin values
Residual predictions add modelled change to the original observed origin; fixed shrinkage is explicit
Unverified input is refused by the CLI before model imports
tests.fixtures: Synthetic software-test fixtures only, confined to tests and temporary test outputs

notes: The caller must pass the registered provider verifier before real training.
Selection reports forecast errors and empirical alert fractions, not confirmed fault accuracy or false-positive rates.
Measured accuracy improvements require a separate final run on verified original observations.
